context.problem_statement: Analyze the provided eCommerce dataset to determine the total revenue generated by each product category. This task will help identify which categories contribute most to the revenue, providing insights into product performance. The solution must include the total revenue for each category.
context.expert_knowledge: Cohort analysis in eCommerce often involves tracking customer engagement over time, focusing on retention metrics and understanding conversion funnels. Analyzing conversion funnel drop-offs can help identify where potential customers lose interest and abandon their shopping journey.
